visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette; zero internal detail.
visual_logic.environment: Cold, bright morning light filtering through sea mist (pale teal-grey).
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: Sharp rim light on the tall curve of the skull and the tip of the tail.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: The distinct 'tall' profile of the skull (not long and thin) is the primary identifier.

pose: Side profile in a walking stance; the silhouette clearly separates the large head, the thick neck, and the straight, needle-like tail.
